programme.desc: S2026 E2 — Ireland v India-2nd T20 Ireland v India. Coverage of the second and final T20 in the series from Stormont Cricket Ground in Belfast. Coming into this series the visitors had won all eight of their matches in this format against Ireland, with the first game being played back in 2009. The last time they met before this set of matches was at the 2024 T20 World Cup, as India won a group match by eight wickets in New York.
programme.title: Live International T20 Cricket

programme.desc: S2026 E3 — West Indies v Sri Lanka-1st Test, Day Three West Indies v Sri Lanka. Coverage of the third day of the First Test in the two-match series from Sir Vivian Richards Stadium in Antigua. The visitors won the last meeting against the West Indies in this format thanks to an impressive 164-run victory in Galle. Sri Lanka made 204 and 345-9 declared in their innings, while West Indies made 253 in their first. The hosts were then set 297 to win but were bowled out for just 132.
programme.title: Live Test Cricket
